what: Preview request list for the final step (builder 3 surfaces). Each name is a view that render_preview.py already knows; draw them at 100 percent (2400 x 1600) crops or at 1200 x 800 first.
how: blender -b --disable-autoexec <garden .blend> --python <surfaces folder>/render_preview.py -- real <outdir> --weather 1 --views hero,rocks,gravel,wall,roof,bridge,lantern,ground,posts   (for the painted look: -- painted <outdir> --views ...)
camera_note: render_preview.py makes its own temporary cameras. For real pictures with the weathering kit on, call weathering_stage.camera_for_picture(camera, picture_height_px) before each picture (render_preview.py does it).

views.hero: the photo camera: whole picture, the one to compare with the original
views.roof: roof edge and eave: tile colour and roughness, moss only on shaded rows, roof no longer near black
views.wall: long garden wall (Right wall behind hall) from the courtyard: peeling plaster, damp foot, cap overhang
views.gravel: raked gravel court: pale grey, rake lines crisp, no pink, stepping stones
views.rocks: pond rocks: scan surface, lichen on the shaded sides, kit moss only at the feet
views.bridge: bridge boards: silver-grey, per-board tone, wear along each board
views.lantern: lantern and the rocks behind it
views.ground: ground near the maple: passages, no camouflage, tiling not visible
views.posts: hall posts, veranda deck, plinth stone

judge: roof not black (5th percentile above about 10 of 255 in the 960 x 640 preview)
no flat pale-green blotches on stones (the kit's patch moss)
bridge boards silver and each a little different
kit_dial_test: render_preview.py --dialtest '{"name": {"wallgrowth": {"moss_amount": 0}}}' draws the first view once per variant; --sweep draws it once per kit layer switched off.
